title: Volunteer
headline:
Be part of
their everyday.
introduction: Behind every animal's care is someone who showed up. Lend a hand at Critter Creek and help with the work that keeps the ranch going.
alt: A miniature horse stands beside a wooden shelter at the ranch.

sections.heading: Care takes a community
sections.body: The ranch's small staff welcomes help with the day-to-day work of a sanctuary. Its volunteer page describes keeping animal areas clean and orderly and helping the team care for the ranch.

sections.heading: Find your way to help
sections.body: Tell us about your interests, experience, and availability. The team will discuss suitable opportunities, current needs, and the guidance you will receive before getting started.

sections.heading: Before you apply
sections.body: The current volunteer application asks volunteers to be at least 16 unless accompanied by a parent. It also asks about availability, experience, references, and emergency contact details. Confirm current requirements with the team.

sections.heading: Groups and community service
sections.body: Interested in helping as a group or earning community service hours? Contact the ranch first to discuss availability, supervision, and any documentation you need.
